cases.trap_rule: Exact quote in a flagged passage under the same clause, or an explicit missing-evidence flag for a fact with no page. Required and suggested touches are reported separately.

backing_rule.rule: Backed when verdict is supports, or verdict is not_enough_information and the separate supports score is at least the threshold. A contradicts or missing verdict is never backed by the score alone.
backing_rule.selection: Maximum balanced accuracy; highest threshold breaks ties. All observed score cutoffs plus 0 and 1, exact fraction comparison.
backing_rule.source: Committed SummEdits sample and cached Jev jev-run1 only; no Readmark cases.

unsure_band.rule: highest bin edge t where the calls below t (n >= 30) are right less than 70% of the time; set after the first live run, because the rule fixed before it (calls at >= t right >= 80 %) gave an empty band; recorded only, not in the gate

checker.rule: A 'supports' verdict counts as consistent; contradicts, not_enough_information or no verdict counts as inconsistent. Positive class = consistent (SummEdits label 1).

cases.riskiest_assumption: The single held-out run required 8 passages (cap n=8) and covered 4 gold required pages (n=8); required reading stayed within eight. Flags touched 3 planted trap facts (n=7) across required, suggested and missing-evidence flags. Its frozen summary produced 14 flags (n=105 claims), whose real-error precision is not independently labelled. The demo summary found two real errors among twenty-two flags (n=95 claims). The reading cap holds; the evidence for finding real summary errors remains the demo, and held-out flag counts alone do not establish accuracy.
cases.trap_rule: Exact quote in a flagged passage under the same clause, or an explicit missing-evidence flag for a fact with no page. Required and suggested touches are reported separately.

A capped gate can lose a gold page as stronger flags displace it.
